# How to make a moodboard AI video models actually follow

**References and a six-line brief become a ranked moodboard.md and board.html in hex, Kelvin and lens mm, proven on test stills.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_1d1bd7ef40dc.webp" alt="The &quot;Last Bus&quot; moodboard scrolls from references, light plan, subject lock and palette down to two test stills of a woman with a red umbrella at a rainy night bus stop." width="480"></p>

Build a moodboard that AI image and video models actually follow, in the order that matters most, and prove it on stills before any video is paid for. Ranked from a 48-still test, 6,086 X posts and 14 official prompt guides: references, light, subject lock, framing, palette, motion, texture, type, sound. Every line is a number or a named thing (hex, Kelvin, lens mm, % of frame, film stock, font, seconds), never "cinematic". Writes moodboard.md and a visual board.html, checks test stills line by line (palette by ΔE), and links 450+ sources: reference libraries, palette, light, type and motion tools, vendor guides, benchmarks, creators' posts. Use for "make a moodboard", "mood board for my video", "style bible", "look and feel", "art direction", "visual brief", "make it not look like AI", or before prompting Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana or Midjourney. Not for finding references from scratch (find-references) or per-shot prompts after the board is approved (varg-video-prompting).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill video-moodboard                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills video-moodboard --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| Needs | no API key |
| Typical cost | ~$0.05 per test still; the board itself is free |
| Uses | Python, Pillow, varg API, Nano Banana 2.1, Seedream 5 Pro |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a moodboard for a 40-second perfume film: night city, wet asphalt, warm sodium light, 9:16"
- "Build a style bible from the three frames in ./refs before I prompt Seedance"
- "My AI shots look generic; write a moodboard with the palette taken from ref.jpg and test it on 3 stills"
